item.title: Tell HN: HN Algolia Search not showing new results from the past 24 hours
item.summary: I frequently use hn.algolia.com which, if you are not aware, is a fantastic tool for searching and sorting through HN. I notice it isn't showing any new results, specifically posts or comments made in the past 24 hours[1] ("We found no items matching your query for this period"). Algolia seems to have had an "incident" earlier today[2], I wonder if the two are related. [1]: https://hn.algolia.com/?dateRange=last24h&page=0&prefix=false&query=&sort=byDate&type=all [2]: https://status.algolia.com/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49423327 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
